slug: 2026-01-27 Cybastion Advances Digital Government Solutions, Supports Benin's SECUROUTE Infrastructure Upgrade

systems.owner: Developed with the Ministry of Transport, the National Police and national road safety agencies; infrastructure upgrade by the Ministry of Economy and Finance with Cybastion
systems.tiers: national platform centralising, securing and tracking road enforcement data from traffic monitoring and regulatory systems

note: SECUROUTE handles road enforcement data only: single-function, so no fact for station records.
